headline: On November 2, 2000: Expedition 1 Arrived at the ISS
captionCards: First 136-day stay on the ISS by Expedition 1
Uninterrupted human presence in space since 2000
instagramCaption:
Expedition 1 began a new era in space exploration. \\[The three-person crew arrived at the International Space Station (ISS) for the first long-duration stay, marking the start of an uninterrupted human presence in space that continues to this day. They stayed aboard the station for 136 days, from November 2, 2000, to March 19, 2001. This mission laid the foundation for ongoing scientific research and international cooperation in space.\\Why is continuous human presence in space important?
